objective: Make Jamie's portfolio safe, accurate, legible, persuasive, and production-ready for job applications without weakening evidence or collective-credit boundaries.
protectedInvariants: No private source material, raw transcripts, private paths, credentials, or unapproved photographs are exposed.
No public claim becomes stronger than its knowledge-bank projection and evidence relationship.
Collective work retains collective credit and explicit role boundaries.
Not recovered never becomes did not exist.
Accessibility, citation coverage, and source limitations may not regress to improve another score.
A human approval gate may not be satisfied by an LLM, repository edit, inferred consent, or absence of objection.

hillClimb.unitOfChange: one bounded hypothesis targeting one failing criterion
acceptWhen: all previously passing hard gates remain passing
the lexicographic objective improves or stays equal with lower complexity
rejectWhen: a score rises by deleting evidence, caveats, credits, or accessibility affordances
a human approval is guessed or self-certified by an agent
the change improves only the grader-facing wording rather than the reader experience
the change introduces an unrelated redesign or broad refactor
stopWhen: the suite target is reached in the required consecutive independent runs
the next failing item requires human approval or rights clearance
three bounded attempts fail to improve the same criterion
the proposed improvement conflicts with a protected invariant
